name: LAN Share App
tagline: A peer-to-peer file sharing app for local networks
description: A peer-to-peer file sharing app for local networks. It allows users to share files with others in their local network.

name: LanView CLI
tagline: Instantly preview full-stack web applications on your mobile device over local Wi-Fi.
description: LanView CLI is an open-source, zero-config developer tool that exposes full-stack web applications to devices on the same LAN through a unified local gateway and terminal-generated QR code. It automatically discovers the host IP, proxies frontend and backend services through a single port, eliminates localhost and CORS issues, supports WebSockets/HMR, and includes a static file server with live reload.

name: TAMX
tagline: A ESP32 handheld inspired by the classic Tamagotchi form factor.
description: A pocket-sized ESP32 handheld — Wi-Fi tools, scientific calculator, AI chat, games, and a PowerPoint remote. Inspired by the classic Tamagotchi form factor.
